name: Dragon, Shadow
body:
SHADOW DRAGON, VERY YOUNG
CR 4

Smooth and obsidian-skinned, the dragon’s every step drips with terror, his nostrils emanating otherworldly smoke which dances with a life of its own.

XP 1,200
NE Small dragon (evil)
Init +2; Senses dragon senses; Perception +8

DEFENSE

AC 18, touch 13, flat-footed 16 (+2 Dex, +5 natural, +1 size)
hp 37 (5d12+5)
Fort +5, Ref +6, Will +3
Immune fear effects, paralysis, sleep

OFFENSE

Speed 40 ft., fly 150 ft. (average)
Melee bite +8 (1d6), 2 claws +8 (1d4)
Special Attacks fear breath (20-ft. cone, Will DC 16, shaken 1d4+1 rounds, once per 1d4 rounds); sneak attack +2d6
Spell-Like Abilities (CL 5th; concentration +5)

1/day–invisibility

STATISTICS

Str 10, Dex 15, Con 13, Int 16, Wis 8, Cha 11
Base Atk +5; CMB +4; CMD 16 (20 vs. trip)
Feats Ability Focus (fear breath), Skill Focus (stealth), Weapon Finesse
Skills Acrobatics +7, Disable Device +10, Escape Artist +7, Fly +10, Intimidate +8, Knowledge (local) +11, Perception +7, Sleight of Hand +7, Stealth +13
Languages Draconic, Common

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Dragon Senses (Ex)

Dragons have darkvision 120 ft. and blindsense 60 ft. They see four times as well as a human in dim light and twice as well in normal light.

Fear Breath (Ex)

A shadow dragon breathes out a miasma of clutching shadows and screaming smoke. Creatures within the area are shaken for 1d4+1 rounds (Will save negates).
